name: task-detail-panel
title: Task Detail Panel
description: An agent task's goal, acceptance and evidence, dependencies that select their task, the pending decision with proposal actions, usage and the attempt timeline. TaskDetailPanel shows it as a non-modal panel; TaskDetailDialog as a modal dialog or a right-side drawer. Escape and a close button close either.
